name: Frosted Navbar
description: A sticky, glass-like navbar with a uniform backdrop blur clipped cleanly to its own bounds, plus an optional lit edge-highlight rim along the bottom.

variations.name: frosted-navbar
variations.previewHint: Scroll the panel — content fades and blurs as it slides under the sticky header
variations.description: No hardcoded height or width: the bar sizes to its content and its parent's width, so it drops into any layout as a <nav> or <header>. The blur layer extends past the nav's own edge for clean filter sampling, then gets clipped by overflow-hidden so it never bleeds into content below.

props.name: as
props.description: Element/tag to render as. Defaults to "nav"; use "header" for page chrome.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the bar: nav links, icons, a search input, a card title, etc.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur strength in px for the main backdrop region. Defaults to 12.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Brightness percentage applied to the main backdrop filter. Defaults to 110.

props.name: saturate
props.description: Saturation percentage applied to the main backdrop filter. Defaults to 110.

props.name: edgeBlur
props.description: Blur strength in px for the thin edge-highlight rim. Defaults to 6.

props.name: edgeBrightness
props.description: Brightness percentage applied to the edge-highlight rim's backdrop filter. Defaults to 110.

props.name: edgeSaturate
props.description: Saturation percentage applied to the edge-highlight rim's backdrop filter. Defaults to 110.

props.name: edgeHighlight
props.description: Set false to omit the edge-highlight rim. Defaults to true.

props.name: edgeThickness
props.description: Thickness of the edge-highlight rim in px. Defaults to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Applied to the root element alongside the sticky positioning classes.

features: No hardcoded height or width — sizes to content and parent, works as a nav or header in any layout
Uniform full-strength blur across the entire bar, clipped by overflow-hidden so it can never bleed into content below
Blur, brightness, and saturation are independently tunable for both the main backdrop and the edge-highlight rim
Optional lit edge-highlight rim pinned to the bottom edge so the panel reads as a physical sheet of glass
Polymorphic `as` prop to render a <nav>, <header>, or any element
Extra DOM props (id, aria-label, style, etc.) pass through to the root element
